languageChangedTo.description: Message that the language has been changed

bannerLabel.message: Show active VMA as a bar at the top of web pages

bannerHint.message: Optional. Requires permission for the extension to read and change the web pages you visit, because the bar is inserted into the page itself. The permission is used only to show the bar. The bar cannot appear on the browser's own pages (e.g. new tab or settings) or in full-screen mode. The icon and notifications keep working regardless.
bannerHint.description: Help text for the banner setting

bannerEnabled.description: Status when the bar is turned on

bannerDisabled.description: Status when the bar is turned off

bannerPermissionDenied.message: Permission was denied. The bar stays off.

bannerError.message: Could not change the alert bar setting

settingsSavedInstantly.description: Indicates the setting is saved without the Save button

whatsNew13_1.message: Optional alert bar at the top of web pages (enable it here in settings)

whatsNew13_2.message: Notifications now show reliably even when the browser wakes the extension in the background

whatsNew13_3.message: The toolbar icon and badge always end up in a stable state

whatsNew13_4.message: The version number comes from a single place (the manifest) across the extension

whatsNew13_5.message: The settings page now follows your chosen language
